purpose: Define the minimum auditable specification contract required for every component and function listed in ATC-COMPONENT-FUNCTION-CATALOG-001.

authority.role: Architecture, integration, ownership, specification and evidence registry only
authority.implementation_rule: This specification does not move or duplicate canonical implementations.

function_contract_required_fields.requirement: Stable, globally unique function identifier; never recycle retired IDs.
Concise capability name matching the canonical source/API terminology where known.
Observable responsibility and explicit non-goals; avoid claims inferred only from filenames.
Exactly one canonical implementation owner; shared or support repositories must not be presented as implementation owners.
Repository, source path, symbol/entry point, exact 40-character source SHA, file blob SHA where available, and evidence URL; lexical matches remain unverified.
Name, type/encoding, required/optional status, valid range/size, normalization rules and validation behavior for each input.
Name, type/encoding, success semantics, determinism guarantees and externally observable side effects.
Required state, authority/capability, initialization phase, caller constraints and environmental assumptions.
State changes, invariants preserved, resource ownership and guarantees after success or failure.
Typed errors, invalid input, unavailable dependency, permission failure, timeout, corruption and partial-failure behavior; no silent success.
Applicable maximum sizes, operation/gas budgets, memory/stack limits, timeouts, concurrency bounds and exhaustion response; use an explicit not-applicable rationale when irrelevant.
Trust boundary, required authorization/capability, untrusted data handling, sensitive state and threat assumptions.
Contract/API/ABI version, compatibility rules, deprecation policy and migration behavior. Cross-repository contracts must be versioned.
Stable component/function IDs, required interface version and failure propagation; dependency cycles must be identified.
Measurable pass/fail criteria, including positive, negative, boundary and regression behavior.
Applicable unit, property/fuzz, golden/vector, integration, compatibility, security and end-to-end tests.
Exact source SHA plus workflow run, job, step, terminal conclusion, exit code and immutable log/artifact reference for any VERIFIED claim.
Use the catalog's readiness vocabulary. Missing contract fields, missing evidence, pending/skipped checks or unresolved critical residuals must not be promoted to VERIFIED or PRODUCTION_READY.

cross_component_interface_requirements.rule: An inferred dependency or source symbol is not sufficient proof of a working interface. Unspecified or untested edges remain RESIDUAL.

status_rules.SOURCE_MAPPED_NOT_FUNCTIONALLY_VERIFIED: Source path/symbol association only; correctness and completeness not proven.
status_rules.IMPLEMENTED: Implementation exists at the referenced source revision; does not imply tests pass.
status_rules.TESTED: Required test set has terminal successful results bound to the exact source SHA.
status_rules.VERIFIED: Contract, source, tests, required CI evidence and applicable security/integration review are complete.
status_rules.RESIDUAL: Any required specification, source, test, interface, evidence or review item is missing or unresolved.
status_rules.PRODUCTION_READY: Allowed only after all applicable production gates pass with terminal evidence and no unresolved critical residual.

fail_closed_rules: Do not infer implementation from names, documentation, source file presence or lexical symbol matches alone.
Do not mark unknown or unscanned functions as absent; record them as unresolved inventory coverage.
Do not claim catalog completeness until all active repositories and public/exported entry points are reconciled against exact source SHAs.
Pending, queued, skipped, inaccessible or non-terminal checks do not count as passing.
No automatic merge authorization, gate weakening, repository lifecycle change or implementation ownership transfer is implied by this specification.
